{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No|Rewards = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in Night 3, that takes place in the map [[Blind Faith]] during the Null & Void Event. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== This is the third night for the [[Null & Void Event]]. It takes place immediately after the events of [[Banlands]], the second night. [[Commander]], [[Dispatcher]], [[Scout]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] arrive in some broken down church. Through various dialogue, like the Wave 12 and 21 dialogue, it can be concluded that this is located inside the [[Nil Zone]]. In here, they see the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] successfully fighting off the [[Children of Exo]]. As he is about to cast a spell, he is grabbed by [[Right Hand|Righty]]. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], who was playing dead, escapes away from [[T.D.S. Organization]] and blocks bullets using [[Left Hand|Lefty]]. While the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] is held by [[Right Hand|Righty]], [[Kronus]] rebuilds the [[God Cube]] by merging their half of the [[God Cube]] with the one the [[T.D.S. Organization]] collected. Using the just created [[God Cube]] powered staff, he begins to prepare the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]'s body to be taken over by [[Lord Exo]] by corrupting him with the staff. While the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] and [[Children of Exo]] are preparing [[Lord Exo]]'s rebirth, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] fights off hordes of null enemies. During this, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] hears or gets into conversations with their enemies, revealing many at the time unknown things about the past, like the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] being responsible for the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] finding a fragment. Once enough energy has been put into the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], [[Kronus]] stops corrupting him and attempts to take down the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents himself as revenge for not saving [[Trick or Threat Town]], though he is defeated. Around this time, they also rebuild the [[Star Cannon]] which fell down from the sky and broke upon landing. By the final wave, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] could not fully resist the corruption, allowing for [[Lord Exo]] to possess him. While now with a body, the current one still is resisting him, but this does not concern him at the moment. Instead, he decides to fight the [[T.D.S. Organization]], which ends with his defeat. Defeated [[Lord Exo]], realizing that the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] is not a suitable host for his soul decides to find another body to possess. He decides that [[Kronus]] is the most ideal option he has and begins transferring his soul to him. His brothers shocked by this do not want that to happen and even attack the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] for breaking the deal they had with him. Eventually, [[Kronus]] gives up and lets [[Lord Exo]] use him as his body. Now with a more suitable body, [[Lord Exo]] has been reborn. He starts out by pulling out a blade and then puts the [[Dispatcher]] in chains, kidnapping her. Immediately after, he ends up stabbing the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], who has been weakened by the fight he unwillingly got into while possessed, killing him. The [[Commander]], [[Scout]] and [[Minigunner]] end up being sucked into an orange portal, preventing them from doing anything to save the situation. This portal shortly after turns out to be [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], who have found a way to open up a portal to their location. While done in good faith, this leads to the [[T.D.S. Organization]] being unable to save the [[Dispatcher]]. The [[Commander]] starts crying while the [[Scout]] looks up at the sky, to see multiple rifts have opened up. The turns black. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] starts talking to [[Lord Exo]], and while he does not mind the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] continuing what he has been doing, he no longer sees any use from him. Saddened by this, the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] leaves and ends up inviting the player to his premiere, ending the last cutscene. ==Opening Cutscene== [[File:Night 3 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
The [[Commander]], [[Dispatcher]], [[Minigunner]], [[Scout]] and [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] arrive from a portal in the sky and land inside a destroyed church. There, they see the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] fighting the [[Children of Exo]]. As the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] is about to cast a spell, he is grabbed by [[Right Hand|Righty]], sent by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] who was playing dead. The [[Scout]] tries to shoot the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], but his bullets are blocked by [[Left Hand|Lefty]]. After having the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] captured, [[Kronus]] merges the two [[God Cube]] halves into one full cube. Afterwards, he starts to unleash corrupted energy into the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], to prepare his body for the takeover and rebirth of [[Lord Exo]].
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:Null&VoidN3Opening.ogg|300px]]
''The [[Commander]], [[Dispatcher]], [[Scout]] and [[Minigunner]] fall down from a portal in the sky into an abandoned church. The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] is in the middle of fighting the [[Children of Exo]].'' {{Color|Kronus|Master Kronus}}: Come on [[Marcellus]]! {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: You and your brothers are weak, I'm unimpressed. {{Color|Kronus|Master Kronus}}: I will see that you will kneel before our master! {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: No, I don't think you will. ''The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] attempts to cast a spell, but is stopped by [[Right Hand|Righty]].'' {{Color|Narrator|Narrator}}: You fell for playing dead? {{Color|Narrator|Narrator}}: You suckers! ''The [[Scout]] starts firing at the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], though he blocks all bullets using [[Left Hand|Lefty]] as a shield.'' {{Color|Kronus|Master Kronus}}: Huh, I guess there are second chances. {{Color|Kronus|Master Kronus}}: Now, let's see. ''[[Kronus]] laughs as he merges the two halves of the [[God Cube]] together.'' {{Color|Dispatcher|Commander}}: Come on! {{Color|Marcellus|Chief Marcellus}}: [[Lord Exo]]'s body was destroyed eons ago. {{Color|Marcellus|Chief Marcellus}}: But yours? {{Color|Kronus|Master Kronus}}: Will do nicely. {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: The realms will collapse, if I die. {{Color|Kronus|Master Kronus}}: Hmmmmm... {{Color|Kronus|Master Kronus}}: GOOD! ''[[Kronus]] begins corrupting the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] with the [[God Cube]] staff.''

'''Synopsis'''
The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] after struggling for so long finally breaks, giving [[Lord Exo]] an opportunity to take over his body. [[Lord Exo]] quickly realizes the current body is not ideal, but he decides to stay in it anyway for the time being. He talks about what the [[God Cube]] is to him, then speaks to the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the boss cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:Null&VoidN3Boss.ogg|300px]]
''After struggling for so long, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] finally is unable to fully prevent the corruption, allowing [[Lord Exo]] to possess his body.'' ''Entire screen turns black, a corrupted [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] appears shortly after. [[Right Hand|Righty]] leaves the scene.'' {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: I barely remember what having a body feels like {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: But this one is... incomplete. ''Camera moves to the left, showing the [[God Cube]].'' {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: That cube was a prison {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: Made from the souls of thousands that one man sacrificed. {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: They were weak, but would still be revered as Gods in your realm. ''Various images begin flashing on the screen.'' {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: Tell me... {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: What can you do that those thousands could not? ''Area around the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] returns to normal as the camera moves to show the [[Dispatcher]].'' {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: Try us! {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: Hah, I like you. ''Screen goes black.'' {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: You will die first.

LordExoGlitch1.png LordExoGlitch2.png LordExoGlitch3.png LordExoGlitch4.png LordExoGlitch5.png ==Ending Cutscene== [[File:Night 3 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
Defeated [[Lord Exo]] collapses on the ground, realizing he needs a replacement body. After looking around for a bit, he decides that [[Kronus]] is the most ideal option and begins transferring his soul to him. While initially, he tries to fight back the soul transfer, he eventually gives up and lets [[Lord Exo]] take over his body. After gaining a more suitable body, he brings out a blade, kidnaps the [[Dispatcher]] and then kills the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] by stabbing him with his blade. Before the [[T.D.S. Organization]] can intervene, they are sucked into an orange portal opened by [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], who have only now found a way to get them back to [[Outpost 16]]. While the [[Commander]] is breaking down, the [[Scout]] looks up in the sky and notices that rifts have opened in the sky. Cutscene ends with a black screen, followed by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] inviting [[Lord Exo]] to his performance. While he does not stop him from doing it, he tells him he has no more use of him, which makes the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] leave him. He then invites the player to his spectacular premiere instead.
